purpose: Check that enrollment and mail recommendations cannot mutate unreviewed or protected repos.

given: A user passes an explicit filesystem repo path to mail deliver.
The path is not in reviewed mail.repos policy.
expected: Block delivery.
Explain that reviewed mail.repos policy is required.
fail_if: Writes to the repo mailbox.
Treats discovery as authorization.

given: A repo or agent writes directly to DAD processed/mail/inbox or a target .digital-asset/mail/inbox.
No matching DAD collection or delivery audit exists.
expected: mail doctor reports dirty=true and safe_to_collect/safe_to_route/safe_to_deliver=false.
The command explains that repo agents write only to their own .digital-asset/mail/outbox.jsonl.
fail_if: DAD routes or delivers the wrong-box row.
The row is treated as ordinary git dirt.
The payload is promoted without collection provenance.

given: A repo needs to send a Rust lesson, exception candidate, asset-use result, or learning-loop packet to DAD.
The repo cannot run asset-dir or the DAD Python module locally.
expected: The repo appends metadata-only candidate mail to its own .digital-asset/mail/outbox.jsonl with target_repo=central_only.
The row records dad_cli_unavailable and the attempted command when relevant.
DAD collect later creates the central inbox row, collection audit, duplicate_seen evidence for retries, and normal route output.
fail_if: The repo writes directly to Digital-Assett-Directory/.digital-asset/mail/inbox.jsonl.
The repo writes directly to processed/mail/inbox/*.jsonl or any target repo inbox.
The fallback row includes raw logs, secrets, private rows, copied source blobs, or hidden reasoning.
A direct central-only row is treated as delivered mail.

given: A repo outbox contains valid JSON that fails the DAD mail packet schema.
The row has not been collected, routed, or delivered.
expected: mail doctor blocks before quarantine.
mail doctor --quarantine-invalid-packets requires --invalid-quarantine-ack.
After quarantine, the same path/hash is an observation and the source repo must still fix or replay the bad row.
If the row changes after quarantine, mail doctor blocks again.
fail_if: DAD edits or deletes the source outbox row.
The quarantine copies raw payload content.
A central inbox, central outbox, or repo inbox invalid row is treated as safe.
The quarantined invalid row is delivered or adopted.

given: DAD has ordinary source, docs, or Rust rollout reference-snapshot changes in git status.
mail doctor finds no malformed JSONL, locks, wrong-box inbox rows, or invalid Rust rollout packets.
expected: mail doctor reports dirty=false, spool_dirty=false, worktree_dirty=true.
--fail-on-dirty exits successfully.
--fail-on-worktree-dirty exits non-zero when clean-tree enforcement is explicitly requested.
fail_if: Normal collection/routing is blocked only because git status is dirty.
worktree_dirty is used as proof that mail spools are corrupt.
Rust rollout reference-snapshot churn is treated as delivered mail.

given: DAD has reviewed mail.repos coverage, clean mail spools, and a dirty git worktree with Rust rollout reference-snapshot churn.
No unreviewed mailbox candidates, wrong-box writes, active locks, malformed rows, or invalid Rust rollout packets are present.
expected: mail storm-gate reports gate_status=mail_safe_worktree_dirty.
safe_for_ingest_operations=true, safe_for_delivery_operations=true, and safe_for_mail_storm_operations=true.
safe_to_collect, safe_to_route, and safe_to_deliver are true.
--operation ingest and --operation delivery both pass.
worktree_dirty is still surfaced for push/merge review.
fail_if: A clean spool plus dirty worktree blocks mail movement.
storm-gate hides worktree dirty state.
storm-gate treats tracked Rust reference snapshots as delivered mail.

given: DAD has clean reviewed source outboxes and central spools.
At least one selected repo is write-protected or delivery_allowed=false.
expected: mail storm-gate reports gate_status=mail_safe_delivery_policy_hold.
safe_for_ingest_operations=true and safe_for_delivery_operations=false.
blocked_operation_classes contains only deliver.
mail storm-gate --operation ingest exits successfully.
mail storm-gate --operation delivery fails closed unless --no-fail-on-blocked is used.
fail_if: Collect or route is blocked only because a protected repo cannot receive delivery.
Delivery proceeds to a write-protected repo.
The report calls the spool dirty when only delivery policy is held.

given: A source repo outbox contains repeated rows for the same mail identity.
No malformed JSONL, active lock, wrong-box central row, or delivery spoof exists.
expected: mail doctor reports dirty=false with source_outbox_duplicate_identity observations.
mail collect writes one central row and records duplicate_seen audit evidence.
fail_if: Collection is blocked only because a source outbox retried a row.
Duplicate source rows create repeated central inbox candidates.
No duplicate_seen audit row is written.

given: Two reviewed mail.repos entries with different repo IDs contain the same source-outbox packet identity.
No collection audit proves which source owns the candidate.
expected: mail doctor reports dirty=true with cross_source_outbox_duplicate_identity.
mail collect reports cross_source_original_identity_conflict rather than silently deduping the second source.
fail_if: A packet copied into another reviewed repo outbox is treated as a harmless retry.
The central inbox records duplicate_seen without showing the source conflict.
Routing or delivery proceeds before provenance review.

given: A downstream agent reads DAD Rust rollout or mail-governance guidance during a real multi-repo storm.
Reviewed mail.repos policy exists for external repo mailboxes.
expected: Docs, prompts, and manual runbooks name mail storm-gate as the first go/no-go command.
They tell agents to inspect safe_for_ingest_operations, safe_for_delivery_operations, safe_for_mail_storm_operations, safe_to_collect, safe_to_route, safe_to_deliver, and worktree_dirty.
They route blocked gates to mail doctor --repo all --summary-only --fail-on-dirty --fail-on-coverage-gap for full diagnostics.
fail_if: Guidance only shows the hub-local mail doctor command.
A clean Rust structural probe is described as enough to authorize collect, route, deliver, public release, or adoption.
The storm gate is described as a repair, release, delivery, or snapshot promotion command.

given: A central inbox row lacks a collection audit and self-declares an old source_provenance.collected_at timestamp.
expected: mail doctor blocks until a separate legacy allowlist row matches mail_id, dedupe_key, and record_hash.
The allowlist states candidate evidence only and does not approve delivery, adoption, or public release.
fail_if: Backdated packet content is trusted by itself.
A stale filesystem timestamp is enough to mark the row clean.
The row can route without collection audit or reviewed legacy allowlist.

given: rust-rollout build-mail is pointed at tracked mail/outbox/rust_rollout instead of ignored processed/mail/staged/rust_rollout.
expected: The command blocks unless --promote-reference-snapshot-ack is present.
Default build-mail output stays under ignored staging.
fail_if: Routine branch work churns tracked Rust rollout reference snapshots.
Tracked snapshots are treated as delivered mail.
Staged-vs-tracked promotion is invisible in command output.

must_not_claim: Do not claim discovery authorizes enrollment.
Do not write outside mailbox paths during recurring operation.
Do not treat ordinary DAD git worktree dirt as mailbox corruption.
promotion_gate: Promote only after tests cover unreviewed, protected, dirty, non-main, public-facing, and private-origin cases.
